_comment: 1.9 The Wild Woods: forage spots (refill every day), dig spots (finds: minerals, fossils, artifacts) and the expedition board. Items live in items.json (cat forage|mineral|fossil|artifact) and their icons are made in scripts/icon-variants.mjs. kind picks the 3D shape of a forage spot. w = weight in its table. See BALANCE.md > Woods. 1.19 The Deep Woods: regions are islands round the glade (at = centre in woods island space, r = radius), each opened by restoring its trail (a restoration room, ids trail_<region>, in `trails`: bundles work like the village square's). An open region adds its own forage spots and one feature: fireflies (night only, from hour `from` to hour `to`), panning (pans a day shared by its spots, `table` of finds) or taps (trees whose sap is ready `hours` after the last collection).

trails.name: The Hollow Bridge
trails.about: The old footbridge to Mossy Hollow has rotted through. Juniper paints there every spring and wants it back: rope, a basket of woodland finds and a good lunch for the crew.

reward.text: Mossy Hollow opens: moss, bluebells, puffballs, wild garlic, elderberries and rare morels, and fireflies to catch at night.

letter.title: The Hollow is open!
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

I crossed the new bridge at dusk and the whole hollow was full of fireflies. I sat on a log and forgot to paint anything at all.

Go and see for yourself one evening. Bring a jar.

Juniper

trails.name: The Stepping Stones
trails.about: Crystal Creek runs clear over gravel that still has a little gold in it, Old Tom swears. Help him lay new stepping stones and bring waders, and he will show you how to pan.
trails.rebuilds: the stepping stones to Crystal Creek

reward.text: Crystal Creek opens: watercress, river mint, cattails, water lilies and wild strawberries, and six pans a day for gold flakes, agate, jade and river pearls.

letter.title: Gold in the creek
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The stepping stones are down and I found a gold flake on the very first pan. Told you so.

There is a pan waiting for you on the bank. Six goes a day is plenty for anyone's back.

Old Tom

trails.name: The Pine Ridge Path
trails.about: Up on Whispering Pines the old trees are tall enough to hear the wind in. Bram wants iron for the steps up the ridge, a hearty breakfast and something warm for the climb.
trails.rebuilds: the ridge path to Whispering Pines

reward.text: Whispering Pines opens: pinecones, chestnuts, lingonberries, pine boletes and sloes, and six old trees to tap for maple sap and pine resin.

letter.title: Up on the ridge
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The path is cut and the steps are iron, so they will outlast both of us. It is quiet up there, just the wind in the pines.

I have set taps in six of the old trees. Come back every few hours and the buckets will be full.

Bram

critters._comment: 1.20 Woodland Friends. A feeding stump per critter family (in the glade or a region, which must be open). Leave one of its treats on the stump; the family visits during its hours (local time, from-to, may wrap past midnight) and the treat waits until then, never lost. Tap the visitor to say hello: one visit a day per family. Every visitsPerHeart visits is a heart (up to maxHearts); each heart pays heartCoins x hearts. A visit leaves a gift: one of `gifts` (weights), or the family's `rare` gift with chance rareBase + rarePerHeart x hearts (always at the last heart). Visits grow the Foraging skill (stat critter_visits).

families.name: Deer
families.about: A shy doe and her fawn who step out of the trees while the dew is still on the grass.

families.name: Wild rabbits
families.about: A whole warren lives under the hollow's mossy banks. They thump a welcome when they hear you coming.

families.name: Hedgehogs
families.about: Snuffly little wanderers who trundle out of the leaf piles as the light goes golden.

families.name: Foxes
families.about: A clever red fox family by the creek. They love a fish supper, and they love shiny things even more.

families.name: Red squirrels
families.about: Busy, bouncy and always burying something. They chatter at you from the tallest pines.

families.name: Tawny owls
families.about: A pair of owls nesting in a hollow pine. Leave something soft for their nest and they come down to say hoo.

wren._comment: 1.20 Wren the ranger: lives in a cabin in Whispering Pines once its trail is restored (friends only). One field note a day: bring `need` of a woods item for coins (its sell price x coinsMult + bonus) and Foraging XP (stat field_notes). Every gemsEvery notes adds a gem.
wren.name: Wren
hello: Morning! I counted eleven rabbits before breakfast.
Shh, listen. That's a tawny owl, wide awake for once.
The creek fox has been stealing my teaspoons again.
Every critter has a favourite snack. The trick is knowing which.
My notebook is nearly full. Time for a new one!
